explanation: For a = b^m (m odd > 1, b not a power) with b₀ ≡ 1 (mod 4), the density is A·∏_{p|m} p(p−2)/(p²−p−1)·(1 − ∏_{p|(b₀,m)} 1/(2−p)·∏_{p|b₀, p∤m} 1/(1+p−p²)). I checked the sign conventions: for m = 1 this reduces to the classical A(1 − μ(b₀)∏_{p|b₀} 1/(p²−p−1)), since 1/(1+p−p²) = −1/(p²−p−1). This matches Wikipedia and LMS eq. (1.4).
